checks.name: infrastructure ownership
checks.message: Infrastructure documentation should define IaC ownership, environment boundaries, and review rules.

checks.name: governance runbook
checks.message: Governance runbook should cover operational reviews, access reviews, secret rotation, and threat model refresh.

checks.name: operational review template
checks.message: Operational review template should include SLOs, error budget review, action items, and owners.

checks.name: access review template
checks.message: Access review template should cover GitHub, Vercel, database access, and least privilege.

checks.name: error budget policy
checks.message: Error budget policy should define SLOs, freeze behavior, and rollback expectations.

checks.name: release calendar
checks.message: Release calendar should define normal release windows, freezes, hotfixes, and ownership.

checks.name: quarterly governance checklist
checks.message: Quarterly checklist should include restore drill, secret rotation, access review, and threat model refresh.

checks.name: release checklist governance coverage
checks.message: Release checklist should include governance and drift detection checks.

checks.name: governance workflow
checks.message: Governance workflow should run readiness and environment drift checks.
